title: Application Follow-Up
intendedUser: Product professional following up on an application
description: Template for following up on a job application status.
template:
Hi [Hiring Manager Name],

I recently submitted my application for the [Job Title] position at [Company Name] on [Date Applied]. I'm very excited about the opportunity and wanted to follow up on the status of my application.

Given my experience with [relevant skill/achievement] and my background in [industry/role], I'm confident I could contribute to [Company Name]'s goals, particularly in [specific area related to the role].

Please let me know if any additional information from me is needed. I'd love to move forward in the process when the team is ready.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your LinkedIn Profile]
[Your Phone Number]
[Your Email]
